V-M-ENGINEERING-GOVERNANCE.Scenario: A significant diff without a valid C-* bundle or outside ObservedWriteScope is rejected.
An applied archive bundle reaches merge readiness while an active bundle does not.

V-M-GITHUB-CI.Scenario: The newest check run for every required name must complete with conclusion success.
Missing, pending, skipped, cancelled or failed checks block the merge gate.

V-M-DATABASE-MIGRATIONS.Scenario: Existing migrations cannot be edited, renamed or removed.
New migrations are sequential and declare upgrade, integrity, backup/restore and rollback evidence.

V-M-CODEX-ROLES.Scenario: Specialist kafedra-* roles operate inside one immutable GRACE plan and explicit handoffs.

V-M-DATA-STORAGE.Scenario: SQLite transactions, busy retry and nested savepoints remain correct.
Migration verification ends with quick_check and an empty foreign_key_check result.
